about: Locks for the 30-second Let It Rip commercial, read by global/scripts/h3_compile.py. Kaiden's top is shown after emblem discovery, with the yellow dragon emblem.
style: The target video is a 2D television sports-anime toy commercial in a landscape 16:9 frame, with bold clean inked linework, vibrant cel shading and simplified hand-painted backgrounds.
Character animation is stepped and expressive at natural action speed; no photorealism, 3D rendering or photographic depth of field.

voices.@narrator: A bright, energetic adult announcer's voice

@kaiden.definition: @kaiden (Kaiden), the twelve-year-old boy with short spiky navy hair, a plain pocketless cobalt-blue T-shirt, black athletic shorts with white side stripes and blue-white sneakers
@kaiden.retain: Kaiden's face, navy hair and wardrobe are retained

@nanao.definition: @nanao (Nanao), the boy with short spiky brown hair, a bright green T-shirt with a white graphic, blue-grey knee shorts and navy-white sneakers
@nanao.retain: Nanao's face, hair and wardrobe are retained

@beyblade.definition: @beyblade, Kaiden's palm-sized handmade top with a blue-red metal attack ring, weathered silver metal, a brown wooden lower ring, visible screws, a yellow dragon emblem on its central bit chip and a conical metal tip
@beyblade.retain: the top's exact layers, colors, screws and yellow dragon emblem are retained, and the physical top never glows

@dragoon.definition: @dragoon, Nanao's manufactured top with a blue attack ring flecked with red and yellow wings, a silver metal weight disc, a red tip and a blue-and-yellow dragon emblem
@dragoon.retain: Nanao's top keeps its exact design and colors and never borrows parts from Kaiden's top

@launcher.definition: @launcher, the owner-labeled launcher sheet; each boy uses only his own launcher as labeled
@launcher.retain: each launcher keeps its owner's exact design: a rigid gear housing with a horizontal grip and a short, flat, toothed ripcord rack

@stadium.definition: @stadium, a portable shallow round grey plastic bowl with a black rim and short feet, about six tops wide
@stadium.retain: the stadium's size, grey plastic and black rim are retained

@kangla.definition: @kangla, the historic Kangla grounds with an open stone plaza
@kangla.retain: the Kangla plaza and its monuments are retained

@kangla.geography: with the stadium on open paving clear of the monuments, Kaiden on its south side and Nanao on its north side

byScene.SC001: Bright monsoon overcast lights the wet stone evenly; there is no direct sun

ambience.SC001: Open-air plaza ambience with light wind and distant birds continues throughout; the spin whine of the tops rises and falls with their speed.

stateLocks.text: Each launcher is held with its grip level and the short rigid toothed ripcord passing straight through the housing; there is no string or shaft.
@beyblade sits flush beneath the launcher's underside mount, tip straight down, and is not spinning.
@dragoon sits flush beneath Nanao's launcher, tip straight down, and is not spinning.

The rack drives the gear while the top is still mounted, so the top spins up before it drops; it releases once, already spinning fast, and lands tip-first. The pulled rack stays in the hand and the launcher is left empty.
@beyblade spins clockwise on its tip with a blurred attack ring, precessing slightly and losing speed only through friction and contact.
@dragoon spins counterclockwise on its tip with a blurred attack ring; the two tops never stick together or pass through each other.
Once @dragoon leaves the bowl it falls under gravity, lands on the paving, tumbles onto its side and stops; it does not come back.
@dragoon lies stopped on its side on the paving.
